title: Storage Agnostic Kit Store With Json File And Folder Implementations
description: Remove all Yjs/CRDT/Sync* implementation from sketchpad. Make KitStore fully abstract and storage-agnostic. Implement JsonFileKitStore for *.kit.json files used by semio/vscode. Implement FolderKitStore using .semio/kit.db for semio/desktop. Remove current yjs dependency from sketchpad. Desktop gets a start page to select/create local kits.
summary: Completed storage-agnostic KitStore implementation. FolderKitStore implemented in studio.ts with KitFolderAdapter interface, undo/redo, file operations, and external update support. Desktop wired with FolderKitStore via Electron IPC (main.ts handlers, preload.ts bridge, renderer.tsx start page with folder selection/recent folders). VS Code wired with JsonFileKitStore via postMessage adapter. Desktop vite renderer config updated with MDX/WASM plugins and path aliases. Fixed desktop tsconfig.json extends path. Added 17 FolderKitStore tests covering all operations. All 65 tests pass. Both sketchpad and desktop builds succeed.
